question: In a quadrilateral IJKL, ∠I = 36° and ∠J = 44°. The bisectors of ∠K and ∠L meet at Z. What is the measure of ∠LZK?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The angle formed by the intersection of the angle bisectors of any two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral is equal to half the sum of the remaining two angles.

⇒ ∠LZK = (∠I + ∠J) ÷ 2

⇒ ∠LZK = (36° + 44°) ÷ 2

⇒ ∠LZK = 80° ÷ 2 = 40°

**∴ The correct answer is 40°.**
